newsitem.title: POLAND: Budimex to float two more subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: Budimex to float two more subsidiaries.

text.p: Polish construction firm Budimex SA, whose subsidiary Unibud SA awaits listing in the next few months, wants to place two other subsidiaries on the exchange in the next two years, Budimex's president said.

Grzegorz Tuderek told Reuters in an interview on Thursday two construction firms -- Budimex Poznan SA, about 78-percent owned by Budimex SA and fully-owned Budimex Rzeszow sp z oo -- would seek for listing on the parallel market.
"In the second half of the year Budimex Poznan should start trading on the bourse and Budimex Rzeszow rather next year," he said.
